name: trommi
description: Chat and decision cards between a person and their Claude Code sessions, end-to-end encrypted
//: test: everything that needs no browser and no hub binary: types, the app's layout, the model, the hub client and the account against a fake hub, the client against a stand-in for what the core's binding lacks. Needs the Rust core built once: npm run build:core.

test:browser: the same layers in headless Chromium (the store and tabs, the build with the core, the MLS proof screen, every demo screen at 360 px without sideways overflow, a picture that did not come keeping its place, the tiles under the Desk's questions, Undo at the sidebar's foot and the groups of Off your mind, the team's knowledge (its page, the search, add, pin, edit, delete), nothing floating over the Desk, Settings → Security, every hover hint one to three words; with TROMMI_HUB_BIN a reload and deep links on a signed-in device against a real hub).
With TROMMI_HUB_BIN set to a hub binary, the hub and account tests also run against the real hub.
WEB_TEST_CONCURRENCY: how many test files test:web runs at once (default: the cores less one). CI sets 6 on its 4 cores: most files wait on timers and a fake hub, not on the processor.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:app && npm run test:web
